g.title: PICO
g.text: QWIIC carries I2C + 3V3/GND to the IMU/ADC chain. SBUS_SIG is
GPIO20 (TX) and GPIO21 (RX) tied together externally at the SBUS
connector (see SbusServoBank.h) -- shown here as one signal net.

g.title: W_SBUS_SIG
g.text: SBUS signal, Pico to shared bus

g.title: IMU
g.text: Default I2C address 0x68. QWIIC_OUT continues the chain to ADS1.

g.title: ADS1
g.text: Default I2C address 0x40 (unmodified). VIN/GND also power the
half-bridge assembly below (see file header). QWIIC_OUT continues

g.title: W_ADS1_EXC_HB
g.text: EXC+ (from ADS1 VIN) to half-bridge #1 V

g.title: W_ADS1_EXC_R1
g.text: EXC+ (from ADS1 VIN) to R1A (bridge #1 top rail)

g.title: W_ADS1_GND_HB
g.text: EXC- (from ADS1 GND) to half-bridge #1 GND

g.title: W_ADS1_GND_R2
g.text: EXC- (from ADS1 GND) to R2A (bridge #1 bottom rail)

g.title: ADS2
g.text: Address jumper bridged to move off the default 0x40 (collides with
ADS1 otherwise) -- resulting address UNCONFIRMED, see file header.
VIN/GND also power the half-bridge assembly below.

g.title: W_ADS2_EXC_HB
g.text: EXC+ (from ADS2 VIN) to half-bridge #2 V

g.title: W_ADS2_EXC_R1
g.text: EXC+ (from ADS2 VIN) to R1B (bridge #2 top rail)

g.title: W_ADS2_GND_HB
g.text: EXC- (from ADS2 GND) to half-bridge #2 GND

g.title: W_ADS2_GND_R2
g.text: EXC- (from ADS2 GND) to R2B (bridge #2 bottom rail)

g.title: ENCODER
g.text: Pin order confirmed on the bench in this repo's earlier EncoderCalibration rig -- same module/order reused here.

g.title: SBUS_BUS
g.text: Shared SBUS bus (signal + servo power rail)
Represents the shared bus all 5 servos tap -- not a physical part,
just this diagram's way of showing one signal/power/ground rail
fanning out to 5 servo connectors instead of drawing 5 identical

g.title: SERVO_PSU
g.text: Servo power supply (battery/BEC, separate from Pico)
Voltage per your servos' actual rating -- NOT powered from the Pico (see file header).

g.title: AIL_L
g.text: Bind to the SBUS channel set for CH_AIL_L (0) in sbusChannelMap[].

g.title: AIL_R
g.text: Bind to the SBUS channel set for CH_AIL_R (1) in sbusChannelMap[].

g.title: ELEV_L
g.text: Bind to the SBUS channel set for CH_ELEV_L (2) in sbusChannelMap[].

g.title: ELEV_R
g.text: Bind to the SBUS channel set for CH_ELEV_R (3) in sbusChannelMap[].

g.title: RUDDER
g.text: Bind to the SBUS channel set for CH_RUDDER (4) in sbusChannelMap[].

g.title: TRIGGER_IN_EXT
g.text: 3.3V logic, edge polarity set via SCPI TRIGCONFIG (default rising).

g.title: TRIGGER_OUT_EXT
g.text: External trigger sink (other equipment, if HastaDAQ is master)
3.3V logic pulse, width set via SCPI TRIGCONFIG (default 2ms).

g.title: HALFBRIDGE1
g.text: Two 350ohm gauges mounted opposite-sign (e.g. opposite faces of a bending element) -- see wiring/strain-gauge-rig.yml for the full rationale.

g.title: R1A
g.text: Precision resistor matching the gauges' nominal resistance -- not a strain gauge.

g.title: R2A
g.text: Precision resistor matching the gauges' nominal resistance -- not a strain gauge.

g.title: HALFBRIDGE2
g.text: Two 350ohm gauges mounted opposite-sign (e.g. opposite faces of a bending element) -- see wiring/strain-gauge-rig.yml for the full rationale.

g.title: R1B
g.text: Precision resistor matching the gauges' nominal resistance -- not a strain gauge.

g.title: R2B
g.text: Precision resistor matching the gauges' nominal resistance -- not a strain gauge.
